text: The Toronto Zoo applied for the Canada Community Revitalization Fund for several projects and was awarded two contributions for two different projects. Details of the Contribution Agreement from the Ministry of Federal Economic Development Agency are outlined below.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the Canada Community Revitalization Fund Contribution Agreement in Attachment 1 to the report (March 18, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo.
